segments.name: Utilities
segments.description: Regulated natural gas and electric distribution utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers in Pennsylvania and West Virginia.
segments.evidence: Utilities - Reportable segment comprising UGI Utilities and Mountaintop Energy Holdings, LLC

segments.name: Midstream & Marketing
segments.description: Midstream energy marketing business providing natural gas storage, gathering, peaking and electricity generation services.
segments.evidence: Midstream & Marketing - Reportable segment comprising Energy Services and subsidiaries including UGID

segments.name: UGI International
segments.description: International liquefied petroleum gas distribution business serving customers primarily in Europe.
segments.evidence: UGI International - Reportable segment principally comprising UGI International, LLC and its foreign operations

segments.name: AmeriGas Propane
segments.description: Retail propane distribution business serving residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural customers in the United States.
segments.evidence: AmeriGas Propane - Reportable segment comprising AmeriGas Propane, Inc. and its subsidiaries, including AmeriGas Partners and AmeriGas OLP

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for delivered propane and LPG, regulated natural gas and electric distribution service, and midstream energy services.
revenueModel.evidence: Comprises (1) firm residential, commercial and industrial customers to whom Utilities has a statutory obligation to provide service who purchase their natural gas or electricity from Utilities

changes.text: In fiscal 2024, UGI sold UGID, a subsidiary of Energy Services, and exited the UGI International energy marketing business in Europe.
changes.evidence: a $55 million loss on disposal of UGID

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, UGI sold UniverGas, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of UGI International.
changes.evidence: UniverGas - UniverGas Italia S.r.l, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of UGI International, LLC prior to its sale in June 2025
